title: What is a rising sign?
description: Learn about the sign that shows the first impression you make on people.

pages.title: The sign rising on the horizon
pages.text: At the moment you were born, one sign was rising over the eastern horizon. That is your rising sign.

pages.title: Your first impression
pages.text: The rising sign shows how you come across: your posture, your tone of voice and the energy people notice right away.

pages.title: A new sign about every 2 hours
pages.text: That is why two people born on the same day can have different rising signs. On average, each sign rises for about 2 hours.

pages.title: Your birth time matters
pages.text: Without the right time, the rising sign can come out wrong. Look for it on your birth certificate.

pages.title: Sun in Leo, rising in Virgo
pages.text: Inside, the person is outgoing and proud. On the outside, they seem reserved and organized. The rising sign changes how you show up.
